links.outcome: Rate of inaccurate or fabricated citations in LLM-generated references
links.effect: 165 of 300 references (55.0%) had citation inaccuracy and 85 of 300 (28.3%) were completely fabricated; DeepSeek-V3 23%, GPT-5.3 69%, Grok-4 73% hallucination.
links.quote: Overall, 165 of 300 references (55.0%) contained a citation inaccuracy, and 85 of 300 (28.3%) were completely fabricated.

screen.reason: Evaluates hallucination and fabrication rates of citations generated by three LLMs (GPT-5.3, DeepSeek-V3, Grok-4) in neurocritical care, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
